notes.mode: 0 calls the actual Block harvest virtual directly;1 calls unchanged os.b(IIII)Z.
notes.held_id: -1 means no selected Stack. Empty current/captured roles use presence0,id-1,count0,damage0.
notes.fault: 0 ordinary;1 sets the actual mined-statistic array cell toNULL;2 sets App.I toNULL;3 passes NULLPlayer to a direct Block body. Sources are restored only after the invocation.
notes.removed: Actual OS Booleanreturn0/1; -1 means directbody or exception before the return.
notes.status: OK or actual caught java.lang.NullPointerException (NULL). Other exceptions fail capture.
notes.statistics: Deltas inspect retained original statistic/writer owners; NULLstatistic roles report0. No synthetic Leaf statistic is created.
notes.random: World.r and JDKMath owner are explicitly seeded outside the invocation. 48-bit states are captured before/after. Each new Entity private defaultRandom constructor entropy is excluded.
notes.item: HL.b is age;HL.c is pickupdelay;HL.d is HoverStart. Positions/motions are SN.aM/aN/aO,aP/aQ/aR; yaw is SN.aS. Floating words are raw lower-case IEEE754hex.
notes.events: Actual pm.a(sn) ItemINSERT and exact-target pm.a(III) CHANGE only. Other real listener methods return normally. Callback reads are passive; all source operations still execute.
notes.event_empty: CHANGE item_id/item_delay=-1; in_world/in_chunk=0. INSERT records actual World.b and Chunk.m membership identity.
notes.order: Each PROFILE is followed by oneRESULT, zero/oneITEM rows, then EVENT rows in actual callback order.
